case_name: Mrs. N Lavanya Sujatha vs N Shivraj Jagadeesh
facts_of_case: Wife filed OP No.1360 of 2017 seeking dissolution of marriage against husband, while husband filed OP No.159 of 2018 for restitution of conjugal rights.

legal_principles.principle: When common issues of law and fact arise in multiple cases, it is desirable that all cases are tried by the same Court.
legal_principles.held: Since there is a likelihood of passing of conflicting judgments if both the OPs are tried by different Courts, and since common issues of law and fact would arise in both the OPs, it is desirable that both the OPs are tried by the same Court.

legal_principles.principle: In case of multiple overlapping petitions, it is desirable to try all petitions by the same Court.
legal_principles.held: Since there is a likelihood of passing of conflicting judgments if both the OPs are tried by different Courts, and since common issues of law and fact would arise in both the OPs, it is desirable that both the OPs are tried by the same Court.

outcome.final_order: OP No.1360 of 2017 transferred to the Court of the Judge, Family court, Secunderabad to be tried along with OP No.159 of 2018 pending before the said Court.
